quoted_from: Linear HAR-129 description: §G (26 live proof checks), §16 (36-step acceptance test), §13 (complete visible demo A-I), Definition of done, Canonical demo checklist + ownership, §A-§I, §5-§12 and the demo surface boundary. Quotes are faithful; implementation-status words after a colon in the checklist are not part of the requirement. Re-quoted 2026-10-04 against the current HAR-129 text: §G, §16 steps 31-36, §13 I, §F, checklist item 13 and §H follow the product owner's rewrite, and the demo surface boundary is added (BND). Retired ids, never reused: HAR129-G-22..25, HAR129-S16-31/32, HAR129-S13-09, HAR129-SF-01..03, HAR129-CHK-13. New §16 rows are numbered S16-33..38 for steps 31-36; checklist item 13 is CHK-16.

sections.title: Definition of Done: visible means live-proven
Episode Replay: time-travel through an account
Learning continuation proof — real loop, not causal experiment
Demo surface boundary — audience sees product, never developer plumbing
sections.reference: HAR-129 Demo surface boundary; North-star acceptance; FINAL DEMO SURFACES

requirements.requirement: replay reset is deterministic
requirements.required_behavior: Reset the replay world twice and observe the same event set, state snapshots and digests both times.

requirements.requirement: no future leakage across the historical/live boundary
requirements.required_behavior: At episode k, no query returns information whose event or knowledge time is later than k.

requirements.requirement: state-at-episode is reproducible
requirements.required_behavior: Materializing state at episode k twice from the same history yields identical state snapshots and digests.

requirements.requirement: Neo4j and Postgres correspond for the replayed account
requirements.required_behavior: For the replayed account the Neo4j projection matches the authoritative Postgres rows (nodes, edges and evidence links).

requirements.requirement: Play releases exactly the next event
requirements.required_behavior: Pressing Play ingests exactly event N and leaves every later event unreleased.

requirements.requirement: graph/state diff derives from that event
requirements.required_behavior: The graph and state diffs after Play name the released event as their source and change only what it evidences.

requirements.requirement: non-material events do not force actions
requirements.required_behavior: A non-material episode records no action and shows the reason it did not trigger.

requirements.requirement: material events trigger the expected real decision path
requirements.required_behavior: A material episode runs the real path end to end (ingest, state, guidance, strategies, evals) and reaches a human decision.

requirements.requirement: all 3 strategies exist before human selection
requirements.required_behavior: Before the chooser is shown, all three complete candidates (action, rationale, evals) already exist in the backend.

requirements.requirement: strategies are materially different, not paraphrases
requirements.required_behavior: The three candidates differ materially in strategy, recipients, ask and rationale, not only in wording.

requirements.requirement: eval routing is state/action dependent
requirements.required_behavior: The routed eval set changes with the state, strategy and action rather than being a fixed checklist.

requirements.requirement: displayed eval results equal persisted EvalBundle
requirements.required_behavior: Every eval verdict and reason shown in Slack or the web equals the persisted EvalBundle record.

requirements.requirement: Slack messages come from real backend objects
requirements.required_behavior: Each Slack message is rendered from the authoritative backend objects, not from a prewritten demo payload.

requirements.requirement: Slack visible-message limit remains <= 3 per decision episode
requirements.required_behavior: A decision episode produces at most three visible Slack messages (M1, M2 update in place, M3).

requirements.requirement: choose/edit/send persist authoritative decisions
requirements.required_behavior: Choosing, editing and sending each persist to the authoritative store against the same DecisionEpisode.

requirements.requirement: edited final artifact is re-evaluated before send where required
requirements.required_behavior: After an edit, the affected evals re-run and the re-evaluated result governs whether Send is allowed.

requirements.requirement: HumanDelta/JudgmentInference is persisted and inspectable
requirements.required_behavior: The HumanDelta and JudgmentInference records are persisted and readable back from the authoritative store.

requirements.requirement: human correction/note history is preserved
requirements.required_behavior: Corrections and notes are kept as append-only history on the same episode rather than overwritten.

requirements.requirement: customer reaction/outcome attaches to the correct DecisionEpisode
requirements.required_behavior: The customer reaction or later outcome links to the DecisionEpisode that produced the action.

requirements.requirement: knowledge lifecycle/evidence changes only through allowed gates
requirements.required_behavior: Knowledge status and evidence change only through the gated lifecycle transitions, never by direct write.

requirements.requirement: later episode/account retrieves only temporally available knowledge
requirements.required_behavior: A later episode retrieves only knowledge whose valid time is at or before that episode.

requirements.requirement: a later chronological episode can retrieve applicable organizational knowledge
requirements.required_behavior: A later episode, reached through the real replay chronology, retrieves the applicable organizational knowledge through the normal context/knowledge path.

requirements.requirement: the trace records whether retrieved knowledge actually influenced the later decision
requirements.required_behavior: The later decision's trace records which knowledge was retrieved and whether it actually influenced the decision.

requirements.requirement: later human/customer evidence can continue the knowledge lifecycle
requirements.required_behavior: Human or customer evidence attached after the later decision refines, weakens, disputes, scopes or preserves the knowledge through the lifecycle gates.

requirements.requirement: complete UI timeline can deep-link each visible claim to evidence/trace
requirements.required_behavior: Every visible claim in the UI timeline links back to the evidence or trace id that supports it.

requirements.requirement: HAR-124 five-minute golden path passes without mocks/fake core
requirements.required_behavior: The HAR-124 five-minute golden path runs against the real integrated system and passes with no mock or fake core.

requirements.requirement: 1. Load the frozen replay world from the approved dataset.
requirements.required_behavior: The frozen replay world loads from the approved dataset.

requirements.requirement: 2. Select a real current account/opportunity and meaningful held-out Event N.
requirements.required_behavior: A real current account/opportunity and a meaningful held-out Event N are selected from the data.

requirements.requirement: 3. Materialize all state only through Event N-1.
requirements.required_behavior: All state is materialized through Event N-1 only.

requirements.requirement: 4. Show the current account / relationship map and provenance.
requirements.required_behavior: The current account / relationship map and its provenance are visible.

requirements.requirement: 5. Verify Event N is not yet visible to the system.
requirements.required_behavior: An assertion proves Event N is not visible to the system before Play.

requirements.requirement: 6. Press Play.
requirements.required_behavior: Play releases the held-out event.

requirements.requirement: 7. Ingest Event N through the real HAR-96 pipeline.
requirements.required_behavior: Event N travels the real HAR-96 ingest pipeline.

requirements.requirement: 8. Resolve Event N to the correct account / people / opportunity.
requirements.required_behavior: Event N resolves to the correct account, people and opportunity.

requirements.requirement: 9. Recompute graph / state and produce an inspectable state diff.
requirements.required_behavior: Graph and state recompute and produce an inspectable state diff.

requirements.requirement: 10. Produce the business-intelligence update from the changed state.
requirements.required_behavior: The business-intelligence update is produced from the changed state.

requirements.requirement: 11. Send Slack Message 1 with state change, why, evidence and View Map.
requirements.required_behavior: Slack Message 1 shows the state change, why, evidence and View Map.

requirements.requirement: 12. Generate 3 materially distinct strategy candidates from the actual state.
requirements.required_behavior: Three materially distinct strategy candidates are generated from the actual state.

requirements.requirement: 13. Before Message 2 appears, generate To / CC / Subject / full action / rationale / eval bundle for all 3.
requirements.required_behavior: For all three candidates the recipients, subject, full action, rationale and eval bundle exist before Message 2 appears.

requirements.requirement: 14. Rank the 3 and identify Ghost's preferred candidate.
requirements.required_behavior: The three candidates are ranked and Ghost's preferred candidate is identified.

requirements.requirement: 15. Send exactly one Slack strategy message containing all 3 candidates.
requirements.required_behavior: Exactly one Slack strategy message contains all three candidates.

requirements.requirement: 16. Allow the human to inspect each candidate without generating a new candidate after click.
requirements.required_behavior: Inspecting a candidate never triggers generation of a new candidate.

requirements.requirement: 17. Human chooses one strategy.
requirements.required_behavior: The human chooses one strategy.

requirements.requirement: 18. Record Ghost preference vs human choice.
requirements.required_behavior: Ghost's preference and the human choice are both recorded.

requirements.requirement: 19. Update Message 2 in place into the complete selected action.
requirements.required_behavior: Message 2 is updated in place into the complete selected action (no new message).

requirements.requirement: 20. Show editable To / CC / Subject / body.
requirements.required_behavior: To, CC, Subject and body are shown and editable.

requirements.requirement: 21. Show why the selected strategy is grounded in current state + company knowledge.
requirements.required_behavior: The selected strategy's rationale is grounded in current state and company knowledge.

requirements.requirement: 22. Show the relevant HAR-97 evals and their reasons.
requirements.required_behavior: The relevant HAR-97 evals and their reasons are shown for the selected action.

requirements.requirement: 23. Allow edit before execution.
requirements.required_behavior: The action can be edited before execution.

requirements.requirement: 24. Require explicit Send.
requirements.required_behavior: Sending requires an explicit human Send action.

requirements.requirement: 25. Preserve the final artifact and human edits.
requirements.required_behavior: The final artifact and the human edits are preserved.

requirements.requirement: 26. Infer the semantic reason for the human judgment.
requirements.required_behavior: The semantic reason for the human judgment is inferred.

requirements.requirement: 27. Send Slack Message 3 with the inference and evidence.
requirements.required_behavior: Slack Message 3 shows the inference and its evidence.

requirements.requirement: 28. Allow Correct / Needs correction / Add note.
requirements.required_behavior: The human can mark the inference Correct, Needs correction, or Add note.

requirements.requirement: 29. Store the human-confirmed or corrected inference in the same DecisionEpisode.
requirements.required_behavior: The confirmed or corrected inference is stored on the same DecisionEpisode.

requirements.requirement: 30. Determine whether the feedback is account-specific or a candidate reusable criterion.
requirements.required_behavior: The feedback is classified as account-specific or as a candidate reusable criterion.

requirements.requirement: 31. Apply the knowledge/eval gates required by HAR-97 so unsupported feedback is not promoted blindly.
requirements.required_behavior: Feedback becomes knowledge or an eval criterion only through the HAR-97 gates; unsupported feedback is not promoted.

requirements.requirement: 32. Continue to a later chronological episode where the resulting organizational knowledge is applicable.
requirements.required_behavior: The replay continues chronologically to a later episode where the resulting knowledge applies.

requirements.requirement: 33. Retrieve that knowledge through the normal context/knowledge path and record whether it is actually used in the decision trace.
requirements.required_behavior: The later run retrieves the knowledge through the normal context/knowledge path and its decision trace records whether it was used.

requirements.requirement: 34. Generate and evaluate the later decision/action through the same normal product path.
requirements.required_behavior: The later decision/action is generated and evaluated by the same product path as the first.

requirements.requirement: 35. Attach later human/customer evidence and allow it to refine, weaken, dispute, scope, or preserve the knowledge.
requirements.required_behavior: Later human/customer evidence attaches to the knowledge and can refine, weaken, dispute, scope or preserve it.

requirements.requirement: 36. Do not require A/B/C, causal-uplift, irrelevant-knowledge-injection, or negative-transfer experiments for current demo acceptance.
requirements.required_behavior: The acceptance path completes without running or depending on any A/B/C, causal-uplift, irrelevant-knowledge-injection or negative-transfer experiment.

requirements.requirement: A. WEB — current company/account world "Here is what Ghost knows before the next event."
requirements.required_behavior: Before Play, the web surface shows the account world built from history through N-1.

requirements.requirement: B. PRESS PLAY — release held-out Event N.
requirements.required_behavior: Pressing Play releases the held-out Event N through the real path.

requirements.requirement: C. SLACK MESSAGE 1 — BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE: what changed, why it matters, evidence, [View account map].
requirements.required_behavior: Message 1 shows what changed, why it matters and evidence, with a View account map action.

requirements.requirement: D. SLACK MESSAGE 2 — STRATEGY CHOOSER: 3 precomputed strategies, 3 precomputed emails/actions, To / CC / Subject / preview, why each, eval summary, Ghost preference.
requirements.required_behavior: Message 2 is one chooser surface with three complete precomputed candidates, their eval summaries and Ghost's preference.

requirements.requirement: E. HUMAN CHOOSES — Message 2 updates in place.
requirements.required_behavior: The human choice updates Message 2 in place.

requirements.requirement: F. UPDATED MESSAGE 2 — SELECTED ACTION: strategy, editable To / CC / Subject, complete email, why, relevant company knowledge, full relevant evals, [Edit] [Send].
requirements.required_behavior: Updated Message 2 shows the selected action with editable fields, rationale, relevant knowledge, full evals and Edit/Send.

requirements.requirement: G. SEND
requirements.required_behavior: Send executes only after the explicit human action.

requirements.requirement: H. SLACK MESSAGE 3 — HUMAN-JUDGMENT INFERENCE: Ghost preferred X, human chose Y, Ghost infers why, evidence for inference, [Correct] [Needs correction] [Add note].
requirements.required_behavior: Message 3 shows the inference with evidence and the Correct / Needs correction / Add note actions.

requirements.requirement: I. LEARNING: decision episode stored; human correction becomes evaluated, scoped organizational knowledge / eval improvement; later chronological cases can retrieve and use that knowledge when applicable; later feedback continues the same knowledge loop.
requirements.required_behavior: The decision episode is stored, the correction becomes evaluated and scoped knowledge or an eval improvement, a later chronological case retrieves and uses it when applicable, and later feedback continues the loop.

requirements.requirement: realistic account activity arrives
requirements.required_behavior: Realistic account activity arrives through the real ingest path.

requirements.requirement: HAR-96 graph/state updates
requirements.required_behavior: The HAR-96 graph and state update from the arriving activity.

requirements.requirement: what changed is visible with evidence
requirements.required_behavior: What changed is visible together with its evidence.

requirements.requirement: account agent is triggered for a clear reason
requirements.required_behavior: The account agent is triggered and the reason is recorded.

requirements.requirement: previous company knowledge is retrieved if applicable
requirements.required_behavior: Applicable previous company knowledge is retrieved before the decision.

requirements.requirement: agent makes a decision
requirements.required_behavior: The agent makes a decision grounded in state and knowledge.

requirements.requirement: evals judge state + decision + trajectory
requirements.required_behavior: Evals judge the state, the decision and the trajectory.

requirements.requirement: human/customer feedback arrives
requirements.required_behavior: Human and customer feedback arrive and are captured.

requirements.requirement: missing judgment / missing eval is discovered
requirements.required_behavior: A missing judgment or a missing eval is discovered from the feedback.

requirements.requirement: company knowledge is updated
requirements.required_behavior: Company knowledge is updated through the gated lifecycle.

requirements.requirement: second similar account appears
requirements.required_behavior: A second similar account enters the same situation.

requirements.requirement: prior knowledge changes the second decision
requirements.required_behavior: The prior knowledge changes the second account's decision.

requirements.requirement: irrelevant knowledge is ignored
requirements.required_behavior: Knowledge that does not apply is not used in the decision.

requirements.requirement: second decision is measurably better
requirements.required_behavior: The second decision is measurably better than without the knowledge.

requirements.requirement: Replay world through N-1 (HAR-130/131)
requirements.required_behavior: The replay world is materialized through N-1 from the approved dataset.

requirements.requirement: A mined and frozen demo case, plus a second similar case; the user picks both
requirements.required_behavior: One mined, frozen demo case and a second similar case exist and are picked by the user.

requirements.requirement: Neo4j subgraph at N-1 and graph diff after N
requirements.required_behavior: The Neo4j subgraph exists at N-1 and a graph diff appears after N.

requirements.requirement: Web Before-Play map, timeline and provenance rendered from Neo4j (HAR-102/108)
requirements.required_behavior: Before Play, the web map, timeline and provenance render from the Neo4j projection.

requirements.requirement: Assertion that Event N is invisible, plus the Play command (HAR-124)
requirements.required_behavior: An assertion proves Event N is invisible and the Play command releases it.

requirements.requirement: StateTransition shown as CANDIDATE or CONFIRMED with its missing facts (HAR-126 → HAR-128)
requirements.required_behavior: The state transition is shown as CANDIDATE or CONFIRMED together with its missing facts.

requirements.requirement: AccountChange and BusinessIntelligenceUpdate writer → M1 (HAR-136/137)
requirements.required_behavior: AccountChange and BusinessIntelligenceUpdate are written from the changed state and drive Message 1.

requirements.requirement: Knowledge → DecisionGuidance → 3 complete candidates → evals routed by transition → Draft1→revise→Draft2 → EvalBundle, with the five questions answered (HAR-117 + HAR-128 policy)
requirements.required_behavior: Knowledge flows to guidance to three complete candidates to routed evals and revision, producing an EvalBundle.

requirements.requirement: M2: choose, edit, explicit idempotent send; edits re-evaluated (E11) (HAR-137; HAR-139 for re-eval)
requirements.required_behavior: M2 supports choose, edit and an explicit idempotent send, and edits are re-evaluated before send.

requirements.requirement: JudgmentInference generator, HumanDelta and verdict/note history → M3 (HAR-119, HAR-139)
requirements.required_behavior: The judgment inference, HumanDelta and verdict/note history are generated and drive Message 3.

requirements.requirement: Correction classified as account-specific or reusable → scoped candidate knowledge → backtest (HAR-119/118)
requirements.required_behavior: A correction is classified, scoped into candidate knowledge and backtested.

requirements.requirement: Second case: knowledge changes the decision, and "Why did this action change?" shows the influence trace (HAR-117 E7)
requirements.required_behavior: On the second case the knowledge changes the decision and the E7 influence trace explains why.

requirements.requirement: Trace viewer and eval registry completeness gate (HAR-122, HAR-140 / PR #44)
requirements.required_behavior: The trace viewer exists and the eval registry completeness gate passes.

requirements.requirement: Real-core Slack smoke, then E2E (HAR-124), then the live Slack smoke last
requirements.required_behavior: The real-core Slack smoke and E2E pass, with the live Slack smoke performed last.

requirements.requirement: Later chronological knowledge-use proof: reach a later eligible episode through real replay, retrieve applicable organizational knowledge, record retrieved → used in the trace, generate/evaluate the decision through the normal path, and attach the next human/customer evidence. HAR-128 A/B/C is not a blocker for this demo.
requirements.required_behavior: A later eligible episode reached through real replay retrieves applicable knowledge, the trace records retrieved -> used, the decision is generated and evaluated through the normal path, and the next human/customer evidence attaches.

requirements.requirement: If a capability is intended to appear in the final demo, it is NOT done because: code exists, a schema/table exists, a unit test passes in isolation, a mock/fake-core path works, a screenshot exists, a fixture bypasses the production path, a developer can explain how it should work.
requirements.required_behavior: None of code, schema, isolated unit test, mock/fake-core, screenshot, fixture or explanation marks a demo-visible capability done.

requirements.requirement: It is done only when a coding agent can start from a documented clean environment, execute the real integrated path, and emit machine-verifiable evidence that the visible behavior occurred.
requirements.required_behavior: A documented clean environment runs the real integrated path and emits machine-verifiable evidence.

requirements.requirement: For a selected account with N chronological events, expose: Account; Episode k / N; Historical learning boundary; Current state as-of episode k; Knowledge available as-of episode k; Timeline of prior episodes; Next unreleased event; [Previous] [Play next episode].
requirements.required_behavior: The replay surface exposes the account, episode k/N, the historical boundary, state and knowledge as-of k, the timeline, the next unreleased event and Previous/Play next.

requirements.requirement: No future leakage is allowed. At episode k, queries must use only information with valid event/knowledge time <= k.
requirements.required_behavior: At episode k every query returns only information with valid event or knowledge time at or before k.

requirements.requirement: For the canonical demonstration, support a configurable split such as: episodes 1–25 Historical Learning Window; episodes 26–50 Held-Out / Live Replay Window.
requirements.required_behavior: A configurable historical learning window and held-out live replay window are supported.

requirements.requirement: Historical episodes must be processed chronologically through the same ingestion/state/learning machinery. The UI must show what knowledge was earned by the boundary and its status/provenance.
requirements.required_behavior: Historical episodes run chronologically through the real machinery and the UI shows the knowledge earned by the boundary with its status and provenance.

requirements.requirement: Pressing Play for episode k+1 must execute the real path: unreleased event → ingest → normalize/dedupe → extract/evidence → resolve/adjudicate → Postgres authoritative update → Neo4j projection → state recompute → state/graph diff → materiality/signal/trigger → decision guidance + applicable knowledge → 3 materially different complete strategies → routed evals → Slack business intelligence + strategy surface → human choose/edit/send → DecisionEpisode + HumanDelta/JudgmentInference → human confirm/correct → subsequent customer reaction/outcome when its chronological event arrives → knowledge evidence/lifecycle update.
requirements.required_behavior: Play for k+1 executes the full real chain and reaches the knowledge lifecycle update.

requirements.requirement: If an episode is not materially actionable, the correct result may be No action required. The system must prove why it did not trigger rather than manufacture an action for every event.
requirements.required_behavior: A non-actionable episode records No action required with the proof of why it did not trigger.

requirements.requirement: Frontend = chronological account time machine, evidence surface, state/graph diff, knowledge-as-of-time, decision/outcome inspection.
requirements.required_behavior: The frontend is a chronological account time machine with evidence, state/graph diff, knowledge-as-of-time and decision/outcome inspection.

requirements.requirement: Slack = actual operational seller surface. Slack must move because the real episode changed the world, not because the frontend sends a prewritten demo payload.
requirements.required_behavior: Slack moves because the real episode changed the world, never from a prewritten demo payload.

requirements.requirement: Both surfaces must resolve to the same stable backend IDs and DecisionEpisode.
requirements.required_behavior: Frontend and Slack resolve to the same stable backend ids and DecisionEpisode.

requirements.requirement: For the live presentation, call these surfaces the web control plane and Cliff in Slack. Internal runners, CLIs, proof commands, and service-management tooling remain invisible.
requirements.required_behavior: The presentation names only the web control plane and Cliff in Slack; no runner, CLI, proof command or service tooling is visible.

requirements.requirement: Do not equate approval with truth. Preserve separately: agent preference; human judgment and semantic reason; customer reaction; subsequent business/account outcome.
requirements.required_behavior: Agent preference, human judgment and reason, customer reaction and later outcome are preserved as separate signals.

requirements.requirement: Reusable knowledge is a hypothesis whose status changes as evidence accumulates. The demo must make these signals distinguishable.
requirements.required_behavior: Knowledge status changes as evidence accumulates and the signals are distinguishable.

requirements.requirement: the later episode is reached through the real replay chronology
requirements.required_behavior: The later episode is reached by releasing the real replay chronology, not by a jump or a side path.

requirements.requirement: only knowledge available as of that time can be retrieved
requirements.required_behavior: Retrieval at the later episode returns only knowledge whose valid time is at or before that episode.

requirements.requirement: Ghost can retrieve the relevant organizational knowledge when it applies
requirements.required_behavior: When the knowledge applies, the later run retrieves it.

requirements.requirement: the decision trace records which knowledge was retrieved and which knowledge was actually used
requirements.required_behavior: The later decision trace lists the retrieved knowledge and, separately, the knowledge actually used.

requirements.requirement: the resulting strategy/action is generated through the normal decision path
requirements.required_behavior: The later strategy/action comes from the normal decision path.

requirements.requirement: relevant decision/action evals run
requirements.required_behavior: The decision/action evals routed for the later episode run and persist.

requirements.requirement: subsequent human/customer evidence can refine, weaken, dispute, scope, or preserve the knowledge
requirements.required_behavior: Human/customer evidence after the later decision changes the knowledge's status or scope, or preserves it, through the lifecycle gates.

requirements.requirement: This is an end-to-end functional proof. It does not require A/B/C variants, counterfactual causal attribution, uplift claims, irrelevant-knowledge injection, or negative-transfer experiments.
requirements.required_behavior: The learning-continuation proof completes through the real loop without any A/B/C variant, counterfactual attribution, uplift claim, irrelevant-knowledge injection or negative-transfer experiment.

requirements.requirement: Every full run emits a versioned artifact such as artifacts/har129/<run_id>/ with manifest.json, environment.json, episode_timeline.json, state_snapshots.json, graph_diffs.json, decision_episodes.json, eval_bundles.json, human_judgments.json, customer_reactions.json, knowledge_history.json, knowledge_usage.json, e2e-results.json, demo-report.md. The artifact must state PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN for every HAR-129 demo requirement and link each PASS to machine evidence.
requirements.required_behavior: One documented command emits the 13 files and states PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN for every requirement with evidence links.

requirements.requirement: For every demo-visible requirement in HAR-129, the coding agent must execute the real integrated system and produce a confirmation record with: required behavior; observed live behavior; evidence; confirmation status; gap if not confirmed.
requirements.required_behavior: Each matrix row carries required behavior, observed live behavior, evidence, status and gap, produced from a real integrated run.

requirements.requirement: A local unit test, schema existence, mock/fake-core run, screenshot, hard-coded UI state, or code inspection alone cannot produce CONFIRMED for a live product requirement.
requirements.required_behavior: No row is CONFIRMED without observed live behavior and machine evidence.

requirements.requirement: The final demo-report.md must include: the complete confirmation matrix; counts of CONFIRMED / PARTIAL / NOT CONFIRMED / FAILED / NOT RUN; direct evidence references for every CONFIRMED row; an explicit remaining-work list generated from every non-CONFIRMED row.
requirements.required_behavior: demo-report.md carries the matrix, the counts, evidence for CONFIRMED rows and a remaining-work list from every non-CONFIRMED row.

requirements.requirement: It should not contain the strategy chooser or a giant draft.
requirements.required_behavior: Message 1 contains neither the strategy chooser nor a giant draft.

requirements.requirement: Every business-intelligence claim must have a trace.
requirements.required_behavior: Every claim in Message 1 links to its trace/evidence.

requirements.requirement: Do not substitute a generic confidence score for evidence.
requirements.required_behavior: Message 1 shows evidence rather than a generic confidence score.

requirements.requirement: The exact bullets come from the selected replay event and state diff, not a hard-coded Acme/Reorg example.
requirements.required_behavior: Message 1 bullets derive from the released event and its state diff.

requirements.requirement: View account map opens the deeper web view with the account graph, activity timeline, provenance and state history.
requirements.required_behavior: View account map opens the deeper web view with graph, timeline, provenance and state history.

requirements.requirement: The Slack message and web map must refer to the same underlying state objects.
requirements.required_behavior: Message 1 and the web map resolve to the same underlying state objects.

requirements.requirement: After the state change is understood, Ghost should generate three plausible candidate decisions from the same current account state.
requirements.required_behavior: Three plausible candidate decisions are generated from the same current account state.

requirements.requirement: Before Message 2 is shown, Ghost must already have created for all three candidates: strategy, why this strategy is plausible, To, CC, Subject, complete email body / action artifact, knowledge used, relevant eval bundle, Ghost ranking / preferred candidate.
requirements.required_behavior: All three complete candidates with rationale, recipients, subject, action, knowledge and eval bundle exist before Message 2.

requirements.requirement: Message 2 should be one compact interactive Slack surface containing all three candidates.
requirements.required_behavior: Message 2 is one compact interactive surface containing all three candidates.

requirements.requirement: Each card must make the option understandable without requiring a new Slack message: Strategy name; one-line strategic intent; To; CC; Subject; meaningful email preview; Why this strategy; Eval summary; [View full]; [Choose].
requirements.required_behavior: Each card is self-contained with name, intent, recipients, subject, preview, rationale, eval summary, View full and Choose.

requirements.requirement: The full draft already exists. View full may open a Slack modal containing the full email/action and deeper rationale. It must not trigger generation of a new draft.
requirements.required_behavior: View full opens a modal and never triggers generation of a new draft.

requirements.requirement: When the human chooses Strategy A/B/C, record at minimum: Ghost preferred strategy; Ghost ranking of all candidates; human-selected strategy; all three complete candidate artifacts; all three eval bundles; account state / state diff; knowledge applied to each.
requirements.required_behavior: The preference, ranking, human choice, all three artifacts and eval bundles, the state/diff and the knowledge per candidate are recorded.

requirements.requirement: However, one click must not immediately become a universal company rule.
requirements.required_behavior: A single human choice becomes candidate knowledge, never a universal company rule.

requirements.requirement: After the human chooses one strategy, the chooser should be replaced / updated in the same Slack message.
requirements.required_behavior: The chooser updates in place in the same Slack message.

requirements.requirement: To, CC, Subject and email body must be inspectable and editable before send.
requirements.required_behavior: To, CC, Subject and body are inspectable and editable before send.

requirements.requirement: They should be the relevant evals for this actual state / strategy, not a static checklist shown on every run. Show specific pass / warn / fail / not-relevant judgments and the reasons behind them. Do not collapse the experience to a single quality score.
requirements.required_behavior: Routed evals show specific verdicts with reasons for this state/strategy, never one collapsed quality score.

requirements.requirement: Choosing a strategy means: This is the judgment/action I want to inspect. It does not immediately send the email. ... then Send is an explicit second action.
requirements.required_behavior: Choosing never sends; Send is an explicit second action.

requirements.requirement: After the strategy choice / send, Ghost compares: Ghost preferred strategy vs human-selected strategy vs candidate eval results vs current account state. Ghost then produces an inference about the semantic reason for the human judgment.
requirements.required_behavior: Message 3 shows a semantic inference derived from the preference, the human choice, the eval results and the state.

requirements.requirement: If the human selected Ghost's original preference, the same mechanism may capture that the judgment was confirmed rather than contradicted.
requirements.required_behavior: A human choice matching Ghost's preference is captured as confirmation.

requirements.requirement: The key learning record is not merely selected_strategy = B. It is: Ghost preferred A; human selected B; Ghost inferred why B was preferred; human confirmed or corrected that inference; human note if supplied.
requirements.required_behavior: The record stores Ghost's preference, the human choice, the inferred reason, the confirm/correct verdict and any note.

requirements.requirement: Needs correction / Add note should open a modal rather than add more Slack messages.
requirements.required_behavior: Needs correction and Add note use a modal, not additional Slack messages.

requirements.requirement: Store the corrected explanation as part of the DecisionEpisode.
requirements.required_behavior: The corrected explanation is stored as part of the DecisionEpisode.

requirements.requirement: Do not promote one human choice directly into universal knowledge. It becomes a candidate criterion / knowledge update that must be scoped and tested.
requirements.required_behavior: A choice becomes candidate knowledge that is scoped and tested before promotion.

requirements.requirement: The live demo has exactly two audience-facing surfaces: 1. Web control plane — Play, account/world state, graph/state diffs, traces, evals, knowledge/history inspection. 2. Cliff in Slack — business-intelligence update, strategy chooser, selected action, human judgment/learning interaction.
requirements.required_behavior: Everything the audience sees happens in the web control plane or in Cliff in Slack.

requirements.requirement: Database/admin CLIs, migration/load/freeze commands, terminal runners, proof harnesses, startup scripts, and similar plumbing may exist to build or verify the system, but they must never appear in the demo or be presented as Ghost product capabilities.
requirements.required_behavior: No internal tool, command or script appears in the demo or its copy, and none is presented as a Ghost capability.

requirements.requirement: The operator may use hidden startup/stop shortcuts or automation before the demo. Once the demo begins, no terminal or CLI should be visible. Play in the web control plane must be the visible trigger for the product flow.
requirements.required_behavior: After the demo begins no terminal or CLI is visible, and the product flow starts from Play in the web control plane, which calls the real backend.

requirements.requirement: Do not move internal verification plumbing into the web UI merely to make it visible. The web control plane should expose product behavior and inspectability, not developer/admin commands.
requirements.required_behavior: The web control plane shows product behavior and inspection only; it has no verification, developer or admin command surface.

requirements.reference: HAR-129 Demo loop clarification (hard demo rule)
requirements.requirement: Every visible transition must be produced by the real system and inspectable. Do not replace hard product work with a counterfactual experiment, a hard-coded narrative, a prewritten Slack payload, or an offline score.
requirements.required_behavior: Each visible transition traces to real system objects; none comes from a counterfactual experiment, a hard-coded narrative, a prewritten Slack payload or an offline score.

requirements.requirement: This verification entrypoint is internal acceptance plumbing only. It is not shown to the audience, is not part of the product narrative, and does not need to be exposed in the web control plane.
requirements.required_behavior: The verification entrypoint and its artifacts stay headless and internal; neither surface shows them.

requirements.reference: HAR-129 FINAL DEMO SURFACES, Product separation
requirements.requirement: Slack is not the eval control plane. Cliff is the user-facing agent. The web control plane is the source of truth for inspection and evaluation.
requirements.required_behavior: Cliff shows concise eval summaries and links; eval inspection happens in the web control plane.

requirements.reference: HAR-129 FINAL DEMO SURFACES, Product separation
requirements.requirement: Cliff does not invent business intelligence independently. It surfaces outputs from the real Ghost pipeline and must be trace-linked back to the same evidence, graph, state, knowledge, decision, and eval objects shown in the control plane.
requirements.required_behavior: Every Cliff claim resolves to the same backend evidence, graph, state, knowledge, decision and eval objects the control plane shows.
